Its nowhere near a perfect game, and isn't a Mass Effect 4, but it's still worth the play-through. Get it for $8 on sale and you won't regret it. It's a solid 7/10, the reason it's so divisive is it's formula breaks away from the original trilogy, being more open world focused rather than small maps as the first three games were. It also has some other notable issues like stiff animations and a generic overarching story. Go into it knowing all that and don't expect it to be a follow up to the previous games, and you'll still have a good time.

I have always loved Mass effect and even played the last three on basically every difficulty with every ending but this has me with mixed feelings. While the game play is stellar everything else is not. I really wanted to like this game but, in the end even with mods to improve my experience it simply never got to an enjoyable stage for me. Mass effect in general is all about the story, what decisions you make, relationships you make on the way, interactions and how everything ties together at the end for the climax of each game. In Mass effect 2 especially where you can effectively kill almost every single one of your teammates if you make the wrong decisions and they will not appear in the third game, that's what made it great. Even though the combat was not focused too much on it was still fun because how everything was presented and handled.

Meanwhile for Andromeda they seem to have made worse versions of every race in the game that seemed lamer and worse looking. Also, you can only choose a human character despite being promised otherwise. Everything feels weightless from your decisions not having many actual tangible outcomes based on your decisions to the actual big bad not even being the least intimidating. Going from the previous three the "Bad guys" don't have any weight as actual bad guys. If anything it just feels like they are bad guys just because and their objectives and reasoning seems trivial at best. The game play loop is worse with the outpost stuff for each world being a bit repetitive with barley if any memorable locations or npcs to speak of. Heck a talking rock would have made things more interesting.

Sure there are a few memorable characters like Drax and Phoebe. But, most if not all of the story beats and interactions are forgettable aside from Drax as he was the only actual Krogen that seemed like a Krogen to me and Krogens in the prier three were always entertaining. Especially Wrex and Grunt provided they survived. While the game play was fun I was just left with a feeling of disappointment as it just felt like the game was stripped down to the appearance of a mass effect game with better shooting and and power gameplay but without much substance where it truly counts. I know the game was only half finished when released but it should have never been released in that state to begin with. lastly if it was just called something else and was just inspired by Mass Effect then I don't think it would have been as bad.
